column1: # Supplement: polyphonic compound corrections that pypinyin gets wrong.
# These entries are merged with bopomofo.tsv at load time.
# Maintained manually — add entries where pypinyin assigns the wrong tone to 為 etc.
# 為 (ㄨㄟˊ wéi) — "to be / to become / to act as"
# pypinyin always returns ㄨㄟˋ for all 為 compounds; correct ones listed here.
# 吃 vs 喫: handled automatically in dict.rs ZhuyinDict::load().
# All 喫-containing entries from bopomofo.tsv are mirrored as 吃 at priority 10M.
# 裡 vs 裏: dictionary only contains 裏 form. Add modern variant 裡.
